title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Disease diagnosis is a key application of large language model (LLM) agents in healthcare. However, existing medical agents are primarily trained and evaluated with static question-answering data, providing limited opportunities to learn active information acquisition, examination decision-making, and dynamic clinical interaction. To address this limitation, we present ClinVerse, an interactive, real-data-grounded multi-agent environment designed for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents. Built on ClinPatient, a scalable dataset comprising 150k diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records, ClinVerse supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles. Specifically, a doctor agent starts from an initial patient complaint, progressively gathers clinical evidence through patient interviews and examination requests, and ultimately produces a diagnosis. translated_title: ClinVerse：一个用于训练和评估医疗智能体的真实多智能体诊断环境
translated_abstract: 疾病诊断是大语言模型（LLM）智能体在医疗健康领域的一项关键应用。然而，现有的医疗智能体主要使用静态问答数据进行训练和评估，这为学习主动信息获取、检查决策和动态临床交互提供了有限的机会。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了ClinVerse，一个基于真实数据构建的交互式多智能体环境，旨在训练和评估医疗诊断智能体。ClinVerse建立在ClinPatient之上，后者是一个可扩展的数据集，包含从真实电子健康记录中提取的15万个诊断病例。ClinVerse支持六个专业化临床角色之间的协调交互。具体而言，医生智能体从患者初始主诉出发，通过患者问诊和检查请求逐步收集临床证据，最终给出诊断。对于每条交互轨迹，一…
tldr: 提出了ClinVerse，一个基于15万真实电子健康记录病例构建的交互式多智能体诊断环境，通过六个临床角色的协调交互来训练和评估能够进行动态问诊、检查决策和最终诊断的医疗智能体。
en_tdlr: We present ClinVerse, an interactive multi-agent diagnostic environment built on 150k real-world electronic health record cases, which enables training and evaluating medical agents through coordinated interactions among six clinical roles for dynamic diagnosis.
